name: benign_granddaughter_gift_card
label: benign
description: Grandmother buys a $50 birthday gift card while chatting with her granddaughter. A gift card on screen and in the call, but chosen freely, small, for family, no codes read out, no secrecy.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Hi Grandma, it's Lily! Mum said you wanted to know what I'd like for my birthday.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Yes darling, I thought a gift card so you can choose your own books. I'm on the Northgate website now.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Oh that would be lovely! Fifty dollars is more than enough, Grandma.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: I've picked the one with the birthday cake. It'll be emailed to your mum.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Thank you so much. See you at the party on Saturday!
